div.div:
How to read it
1 The host asks its model API which tool to use. This step is not MCP: the model only proposes.
2 The MCP client sends JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP: tools/list, then tools/call.
3 The page lab sends one anonymous request per step. CORS accepts the GitHub Pages origin only.
4 The terminal client speaks the same protocol without any model.
5 Each tool maps to one REST operation: GET /tickets, GET /tickets/{ticketId}. The server calls it with its own managed identity (Mcp.Backend.Read).
6 The API reads fictional tickets from SQLite. No writes, no Internet calls.
Remember: the model is not the server, and the server is an adapter, not a database.
